plugins.description: Free, open-source Google Ads analyst for Claude, built from playbooks used to manage tens of millions in ad spend. Works with Google's official Google Ads MCP, no subscription. Runs a 128-check account health check across Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Display, Video and Demand Gen; finds wasted spend in search terms and proposes negative keywords; covers Quality Score, keyword cannibalisation, budget pacing, CPA and ROAS variance, conversion tracking, media plans and weekly PPC reports. Unofficial; not affiliated with Google.
